name: CloudCost Radar
tagline: Daily AWS compute prices, spot moves and cheaper-alternative math
description: CloudCost Radar tracks AWS EC2 on-demand, spot and reserved prices across 20 regions every day, and compares them with cheaper cloud and VPS alternatives. Free daily price data, spot-price movers and a savings calculator.
disclosure: CloudCost Radar is reader-supported. Some links to cloud providers are referral links: if you sign up we may earn a credit at no extra cost to you. Referral partnerships never affect prices, rankings or recommendations, which are computed from published provider pricing data.

data_sources.name: ec2.shop public EC2 price API
data_sources.note: Machine-readable AWS EC2 on-demand, spot and reserved prices, region by region.
